messages:
sara: hey team — customer BrightCorp (andy_brightcorp) reporting repeated 502s and long timeouts from hosted inference API since ~09:10 UTC. They saw a sharp spike in errors and most requests now return 502 or hang for >10s.
andy_brightcorp: yep, we're seeing it on our side. Example: POST /v1/generate -> 502, then retries pile up. Happening across regions (us-east/us-west).
tom: looking at infra alerts — memcached pool 'pfx-cache-main' showing auth failures and connection timeouts starting 09:08. Alerts: "memcached: auth rejected" + high connection churn.
liam: that aligns with traces — gateway shows upstream 502 from edge-cache-proxy when trying to read prefix key. I've pulled an example trace: 
```
upstream_response_time: 0.002, 0.000, 0.000
upstream_status: 200, 502, 502
error: memcached ERR auth failure on 10.12.8.45
```
sara: customer repro steps: they call hosted endpoint normally with api key and model param. When cache hits fail, service falls back to model backend but those fallbacks are saturating and leading to 502s. They provided curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-large","input":"Hello"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
```

liam: quick summary of the failure mode I'm seeing: 1) memcached auth tokens expired on a subset of nodes after a KMS rotation 2) clients get ERR and gateway retries -> fallback path invokes heavier model calls 3) request queueing at model layer causes 502s/timeouts back to API.
elaine: any chance this is related to the customer billing key rotation we did last night? We rotated a subset of service credentials for cache writes only.
tom: yes, config audit shows a rotated cache service token rolled out to some hosts but not all; mismatched tokens cause auth rejections on older memcached instances. Patch rollouts were partial around 09:05–09:07.
ops-bot: Deploy #deploy-17891 completed at 2026-03-17T09:06:12Z (canary 10%).
sara: steps taken so far: - scoped incident, escalated to eng-runtime (liam) and infra (tom) - disabled cache-writes fallback on gateway for affected prefix to stop fallback loop - contacted BrightCorp with preliminary findings and mitigation steps.
liam: mitigation plan: 1) rollback token rotation to previous token set for memcached cluster OR push full rollout of new token to all memcached nodes (prefer full rollout) 2) temporarily increase connection pool size and reduce gateway retry multiplier to avoid amplifying load 3) add short-circuit to return 503 with informative body when cache backend auth fails to avoid expensive fallbacks.
andy_brightcorp: appreciate the quick response. Can you confirm if we should pause heavy traffic? We're running a batch that is spiking our requests.
tom: please pause if you can — it will help reduce cascading retries. We'll attempt a full token rollout now.
liam: rolling token rollout in progress — pushing new token to remaining nodes (target complete in 5m). Also enabling a short-term 100ms circuit breaker on cache reads for affected prefix.
ops-bot: memcached cluster update job started at 2026-03-17T09:18:04Z.
liam: update: rollout reached 100% at 09:23, connection auth errors dropped to near-zero. We're seeing request success rates recover, though some model-backend queues remain warm.
elaine: noting billing/usage impact: because of retries, BrightCorp saw ~2.3x token usage between 09:10–09:25. We'll flag for credits/adjustment after postmortem.
sara: customer update sent — told them we pushed full token rollout and temporary mitigations; asked them to resume traffic slowly.
andy_brightcorp: resuming now at 10% traffic — initial checks look good, no 502s in first 2 minutes. Thanks.
liam: permanent follow-ups: - improve rollout atomicity for cache tokens (ensure zero-diff during rotation) - add a specific metric for memcached auth failures and automated pause of fallback path when >X errors/min - add runbook for cache-service token rotation.
tom: postmortem owner: eng-infra. I'll add logs and timeline. We'll schedule a hotfix to make token rotation reversible and safe.
sara: closing loop with customer in 1h with formal RCA + credit proposal. If anyone sees additional regression, ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
